machine.name: Universe 7
machine.decode_order: Most significant two bits first; cyclic four-instruction program.
machine.pixel_order: Bit i is pixel x=i%8, y=i//8; top-left is bit 0.
machine.head_update: Apply pixel operation at old head, then add stride modulo 64.
machine.scope: No inputs, arithmetic registers, conditionals, or code mutation; outputs are screens.

metric_definitions.lit_pixels: Lit pixels on the final screen after 127 instructions.
metric_definitions.visited_pixels: Distinct positions at which a pixel operation executed within the first 127 instructions.
metric_definitions.pixel_changes: Instructions that changed a pixel within the first 127 instructions; set/clear can leave a pixel unchanged.
metric_definitions.equivalent_program_ids: Exactly the programs with the same final screen at step 127, including this program; trajectories need not match.
metric_definitions.symmetries: Geometric symmetries of the final 8x8 screen, with the screen center fixed.
metric_definitions.cycle: Exact eventual cycle of (screen, head, next instruction index) if execution continues indefinitely. The observer searches beyond step 127 when needed; saved traces still end at 127.
